label: Diagram 14
caption: Diagram 14 Accessible threshold for use in exposed areas128 (see paragraph 5.33)
description: This is a section drawing titled "Diagram 14 Accessible threshold for use in exposed areas (see paragraph 5.33)". It shows a cut through an external wall at floor level. A grey mass labelled "Sill" forms the centre, with a tall vertical rectangular outline rising above it. To the left, a grey area labelled "External landing" has a top surface drawn at about the same height as the top of the sill; this surface is sloping and indicated by an arrow labelled "Minimum fall 1:60". A vertical dimension with double arrows on the left reads "At least 125mm", spanning between the top of the external landing and a lower horizontal line. A dashed vertical line is labelled "Line of external wall". A small gap in the threshold at the left of the sill is labelled "Drainage slot". On the right side, a sloping surface is labelled "Internal transition unit (where necessary)", and a small component at the top of this slope is labelled "Weather seal".
